messages:
Clare (CS): Heads-up — Orion is greenlit to start dedicated bring-up next Tue. Main asks: quota commit, autoscale policy, and a short load sanity run.
Devon (SRE): Copy. What's their committed QPS and burst profile?
Clare (CS): They committed to 1200 steady QPS with 3x short bursts (~3600) for 10m during promotions.
Sam (PM): We should gate on autoscale headroom + prefix cache priming. Recommend reserve 2x warm GPUs for first 48h.
Devon (SRE): Sounds right. I'll preregister a reserved pool and set scale_policy := {min_nodes:2, max_nodes:10, scale_step:1, cool_down:60s}.
Clare (CS): Can you paste the exact policy so Customer can approve?
Devon (SRE): Sure —
```json
{"scale_policy":"min:2,max:10,step:1,cooldown:60s","cpu_target":"65%","gpu_margin":"20%"}
```
Clare (CS): Perfect. Maya — can you confirm Orion accepts that envelope?
Maya (Customer): Yes we can accept that. One ask: can you run a short smoke load on Mon night (low traffic) to validate priming?
Sam (PM): Mon 02:00–03:00 PT works for our ops. We'll do a controlled spike and validate latency P95 < 200ms.
Devon (SRE): I'll schedule a canary run + full smoke. Proposed load command:
```bash
rload --target https://api.redwood.example/dedicated/orion --profile spike --qps 1200 --burst 3600 --duration 15m --threads 60
```
Devon (SRE): We'll stream logs to /var/logs/dedicated/orion-smoke and attach traces to the run. opsbot will post start/finish.
opsbot: Scheduled job 3471234567-smoke-run at 2026-03-23T02:00:00Z.
Clare (CS): Also plan KV cache priming — Sam can you share top 20 prompt prefixes from Orion's prod test dataset?
Sam (PM): Sending the list in 10m via secure link. Make sure priming uses small batch sizes to hit cache quickly.
Devon (SRE): Noted. For fallback: we'll set routing policy to prefer dedicated but fallback to hosted-lite model if tail latency > 1s for >2min. Agree?
Clare (CS): Agree. Add alert: "orion.dedicated.tail_latency_fallback" to CS on-call and customer.
Maya (Customer): Good. One more: can we get a pre-cutover readiness checklist? I want a short runbook to hand to my infra team.
Clare (CS): Yep — I'll produce a 1-page runbook: target times, rollback steps, contact list, and smoke thresholds.
Devon (SRE): Action items:
- Devon: provision reserved pool + apply scale_policy (ETA Mon 10:00 PT)
- Sam: share prefix list (ETA in 10m)
- Clare: write 1-page runbook (ETA Mon 16:00 PT)
- Maya: approve policy and participate in Mon night smoke (confirm now)
Maya (Customer): Approved. We'll have two engineers on the call.
Clare (CS): Thanks all :thumbsup: — I'll update this thread with the runbook and opsbot logs.
opsbot: Job 3471234567-smoke-run completed at 2026-03-23T02:18:00Z — peak QPS 3600, P95 180ms, no errors >1%
Devon (SRE): Smoke looks good from infra side. Proceed to warmup the rest of the tokens tomorrow night, then go-live window Tue 11:00 PT.
Clare (CS): Marking go-live tentative Tue 11:00 PT. Closing coordination loop here unless someone has blockers. :eyes:
